components.name: method
values: scgen vae + latent vector arithmetics | scgen uses a variational autoencoder vae to model the conditional distribution p x_i z_i p_i where x_i is expression profile z_i is low-dimensional latent representation and p_i is the condition unperturbed/perturbed . latent space vector arithmetics is used to extrapolate to unseen conditions δ = avg z_condition=1 - avg z_condition=0 . for out-of-sample predictions the perturbation vector is computed from training cell types and applied to held-out cell types. architecture adapted for scrna-seq data. implemented in tensorflow and scanpy.

components.name: method
values: cross-study prediction with scgen | the perturbation vector δ is estimated from the training study kang et al. study a . the latent representations of control cells from study b are shifted by δ to predict stimulated cells in study b.
